title: Best Foods After Dental Implant Surgery: 10 Top Picks
seoTitle: Best Foods After Dental Implant Surgery
seoDescription: Soft, protein-rich foods that protect your implant site and support healing, phase by phase. Get a recovery plan from our Santa Clarita team.
excerpt: What to eat in the first days, the first week and the first month after implant surgery, plus the foods and habits to avoid while the site heals.
keyTakeaways: Days 0 to 3: stick to cool liquids and purees such as broth, yogurt, smoothies by spoon and soft eggs.
Skip straws for at least 7 to 10 days; suction can dislodge the clot at the surgical site.
Avoid hard, crunchy or sticky foods for 4 to 8 weeks, or until your clinician clears you to chew normally.
Protein, vitamin C, zinc, calcium and vitamin D support tissue and bone healing around the implant.
Call if bleeding persists past 24 hours, pain is uncontrolled, fever passes 100.4 F or swelling worsens after 72 hours.
imageAlt: Bowl of soft foods: fish, avocado, banana and eggs
